decisions.reason: The Black Edition fits the firm's established design-led range and was upgraded to its own page in 2024, which signals results at or above aspiration, so there is no trigger for problemistic search and dropping it would release few resources.
CeraFrame Liquid has had its own page in both years and addresses the growing market for seamless, barrier-free bathrooms, so it meets aspirations and matches the firm's strategic direction.

The pump-drain channel is newly launched and its results are still uncertain, but the growing industry and the firm's slack let it carry the product, and it appears to replace the withdrawn Product C, so the firm has already done its search in this segment.
